note: the player layer's items (system doc 2026-09-13 §7 build 3; design §4.2 stack sizes, crafting §5, loot §3). The mod registers every entry (gscraft.war.item.SliceItems); tools/items.py writes the models, placeholder textures and names. gscraft:bandage is the mod's own item and is not listed here.

items.name: Bolt
items.tip: Hardware. Four with four nuts, screws and nails make a fastener kit.

items.tip: Hardware. Goes with a bolt.
